title: 八点

series.next: Season one is over. Next year, on this date, your phone will ring, and you'll know who it is.

setting: 红星饭店, open for one night only. Saturday, 7:58 pm. The table for two at eight.

steps.narr: 红星饭店, for one night. Red lanterns, eight tables, and one of them laid. 7:58.

say.en: Ask 红姐 for her signature dish.
say.gloss: 红姐, your best dish, please!
say.tip: 拿手 náshǒu = good at, expert: 拿手菜 = the dish you do best.

ok.zh: 好嘞！红烧肉，十年没做了。
ok.en: Coming up! Braised pork. I haven't made it in ten years.

answers: 红姐，把您的拿手菜都端上来！
3.gloss: 红姐, bring out all your best dishes!

steps.narr: Just the two of you, by the window. 红姐 peeks out of the kitchen, and pretends not to.

else.en: I'll sit with you a minute.
That night ten years ago, it was raining.

else.zh: 八点四十，那个人进来，问八点那桌的人呢。
else.en: At twenty to nine, they came in and asked where the table at eight had gone.

steps.narr: Two glasses. 红姐's own plum wine.

say.en: Raise a toast: to ten years!
say.tip: 敬 jìng = drink to: 敬这十年 = to these ten years. 为……干杯 says it too.

3.gloss: This glass is to ten years. Cheers!

steps.en: And you? Tonight... how do you feel?

say.en: Say how you feel: you're glad to be here.
say.gloss: I'm really glad to be here tonight.

answers: 能跟你一起在这儿，我很高兴。
3.gloss: Being here with you makes me really happy.

steps.narr: 8:39. 程远 keeps looking at the clock over the door.
程远 puts the phone face down on the table.

steps.en: Ten years ago, I waited here.
Tonight, I don't want to wait any more.
Next time... will you book the table?

say.en: Say yes, you'll book it, or that you'd like to take it slowly.
say.tip: 订 dìng = book, reserve: 订位子 = book a table.

answers: 我早就订好了，明年今天。

then.narr: 红姐 comes out of the kitchen with the old booking book, and opens it at next year.

then.zh: 明年今天，八点，两个人。早就订了。
then.en: Next year, this date, eight o'clock, two people. Booked weeks ago.

then.narr: 程远 laughs, and then can't stop crying, and then laughs again.

then.en: Next year's table at eight is already yours. Nobody has to wait for anyone. 🏮

answers: 好，下次我来订，八点那桌。
3.gloss: Yes. Next time I'll book: the table at eight.

alts.gloss: No hurry. Let's take it slowly, shall we?

steps.en: Midnight. 红姐 waves you off from the door, the booking book under her arm. Season one ends here. 🏮

else.en: You walk home slowly. Neither of you mentions next year. Both of you are thinking about it. Season one ends here. 🏮
